title: Yellow Split Pea Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with yellow split peas, vegetables, and a hint of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the dried yellow split peas, canned diced tomatoes, water, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the peas are tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
